title: See Which Posts Bring Results from Your Own Records
summary: Keep your own dated record of X results and unanswered replies, then plan each morning from what actually worked instead of guessing.

steps: Set a daily X API spend cap and turn on the reply and analytics helpers.
Answer the unanswered replies list each day yourself.
Read the morning brief and pick one draft to edit.
Check timing advice, then post by hand.
guardrails: None of the bots post, follow or message for you.
Learn from patterns in other posts; never copy their wording.
